baseSurvivalDC.Name: Starting Survival DC
baseSurvivalDC.Hint: The Survival DC the journey starts at, and the value the running DC goes back to when the GM resets it.

survivalDC.Name: Current Survival DC
survivalDC.Hint: The running Survival DC. It grows by one after every area activation.

intelligenceDC.Name: Intelligence DC
intelligenceDC.Hint: DC of the Intelligence check that lets a player remember the visited areas next to the active one.

survivalFormula.Name: Survival check formula
survivalFormula.Hint: Roll formula for Survival checks, evaluated with each character's roll data. Missing values count as 0. The default fits D&D 5e.

intelligenceFormula.Name: Intelligence check formula
intelligenceFormula.Hint: Roll formula for Intelligence checks, evaluated with each character's roll data. Missing values count as 0. The default fits D&D 5e.

randomRotation.Name: Rotate the map
randomRotation.Hint: When an area is activated, rotate the whole map by a random angle around it.

blackoutDuration.Name: Blackout fade (ms)
blackoutDuration.Hint: How long the fade to and from black takes when the active area changes.

SceneConfig.EnableHint: Turn this scene into a WonderMap: no grid, no token vision, areas connected by paths. The scene background image fills the whole screen as a fixed backdrop.

Controls.Title: WonderMaps
Controls.Select: Select: left-click an area to see its full art, right-click it for its menu (walk here, edit...). Click a crossroad to roll its Survival check. Drag to move.
Controls.Area: Add area: click on the map
Controls.Crossroad: Add crossroad: click on a path to split it with a crossroad
Controls.Connect: Connect: drag from an area or crossroad and release on another to draw a path
Controls.ResetConfirm: Clear the active area, the visited areas and the players' arrows on this map? The Survival DC is not changed.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.FrameImageHint: Optional. A ring image drawn over the circle instead of the coloured frame.
Fields.RollTableHint: Rolled blindly every time the party walks into this area. Only the GM sees the result.
Fields.TracksHint: Resources or clues hidden in this area. Only the GM sees them, as small circles at the top-right of the area. Click one on the map to roll for the party to find it.
Fields.TravelTimeHint: How long it takes to walk this path. Walking to an area adds up the paths of the route and advances the world time (doubled on difficult terrain).
Fields.LandmarkHint: Players see this area (in full colour) whenever the party is in an area connected to it by a path, whatever their checks. The GM sees an eye on its bottom left.
Fields.HiddenHint: Players never see this area as a remembered or always-visible neighbour, until you reveal it (also from its right-click menu). They still see it while the party is in it. The GM sees it faded.
Fields.LinkedSceneHint: The GM gets a shortcut on this area (red bullseye, top left) that activates this scene for everybody. With SnapScene active you can first pick a snapshot of it to restore.

DC.Title: Survival DC
DC.Hint: The DC grows by one after every area activation and carries over between scenes. Reset sets it back to {base} (change the starting value in the module settings).

Chat.NoParty: The party is empty: drag actors onto the WonderMaps party panel.
Chat.NoRoute: No path leads here: no time passed.

Notify.PathExists: Those two points are already connected.
Notify.CrossroadOnPath: Crossroads go on paths: click on a path to place one.
Notify.PathEnds: A path must end on an area or a crossroad: release the mouse over one.
Notify.CascadeConfirm: This deletes {paths} path(s) and {crossroads} crossroad(s) connected to it. Areas are kept. Continue?

Errors.BadFormula: WonderMaps: invalid roll formula "{formula}". Rolled a plain d20 instead.
Errors.NoExhaustion: WonderMaps: {name} has no exhaustion value (system.attributes.exhaustion) in this game system.

Panel.Title: Party
Panel.RemoveConfirm: Remove {name} from the party? Checks will no longer be rolled for them.
Panel.Empty: Drag actors (or a folder of actors) here from the Actors tab. Checks are rolled only for the actors in this list.
Panel.ResetTurnsConfirm: Set the turn counter back to 0?
Panel.OnlyActors: WonderMaps: only world actors can join the party.
Panel.ResetRotationConfirm: Turn the map back so that north points up? The screen blacks out as usual. Players' arrows keep their angle from north.
Panel.ResetAllConfirm:
Reset everything on this map?
• active area, visited areas and players' arrows cleared
• rotation back to north up
• Survival DC back to {base}
• turns back to 0
• last check results cleared
• time in the area and travel since long rest back to 0
The party members stay in the list.
Panel.SizesHint: Default size of new areas and crossroads on this map. Areas and crossroads that still have the old default size follow the change; the ones you resized keep their size.
Panel.PlayerColor: Player colour (the colour of their arrow)
Panel.AlwaysNorth: Always knows north: this character's arrow points north whatever their Survival check

Route.Title: Which way?
Route.Hint: Several routes lead there. Pick the one the party took:

Travel.AreaTimeHint: World time passed since the exploration started (first move, or the last "Reset everything").
Travel.SinceRest: Travelled since the last long rest
Travel.RestAllConfirm: Mark a long rest as taken for the whole party? Their travel counters go back to 0.
Travel.ExhaustAllConfirm: Give 1 level of exhaustion to every party member?
Travel.AddRestTime: +8 hours (long rest). Does not reset the travel counters: use the bed buttons for that.
Travel.CountAsTravelHint: Adds this time to every party member's "travelled since the last long rest" too.

CopyTrack.Title: Copy track to other areas
CopyTrack.Hint: Add a copy of {name} to the areas you tick. Each copy can have its own DC.
CopyTrack.NoAreas: There are no other areas on this map.

SceneLink.Title: Activate scene
SceneLink.ChooseHint: {scene} has SnapScene snapshots. Restore one before activating it?
SceneLink.Missing: WonderMaps: the linked scene no longer exists.
SceneLink.RestoreFailed: WonderMaps: SnapScene restore failed ({error}). The scene was not activated.
SceneLink.RestoreWarnings: WonderMaps: the snapshot was restored with {n} problem(s), see the console.
